entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help. I bought a jersey a little while ago, and I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's just the wrong size. I was so excited for it, but when I finally tried it on for a ride, it was just way too tight. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was really counting on this. I feel terrible even calling about it.

Not a problem at all, that's what we're here for. It's important that your gear fits perfectly. Let me just pull up your account... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 49 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I've had some things come up... I was so worried I was too late. I really needed this money back.
No need to worry. For our standard apparel like this jersey, we have a 90-day return policy. You are well within the window. We can absolutely get this processed for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much.
Of course. My system gives me two options. I can process a full refund back to your original payment method, or I can set up an exchange for the correct size. Do you have a preference?
You know, a refund would be best for now. Thank you for offering the exchange, though. That's very kind.

Alright, a refund it is. And since you're a VIP member and have been with us for so long, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee for you. I've just sent the prepaid shipping label to your email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed.
Wow, Alex, that's amazing. You've completely turned my day around. Thank you for being so helpful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
